>
[Lasting Armament](/Feats.aspx?ID=4690) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 119

**Prerequisites**
[Sanctify Armament](/Feats.aspx?ID=4671)

</column>

---

When you sanctify a weapon, it remains sanctified for an extended period. The duration of Sanctify Armament is increased to 1 hour, but it still ends if you use Sanctify Armament on another weapon.
name: Lasting Armament
